label: Additional privileged-present…: An additionally designated relation on events proposed as…
definition: An additionally designated relation on events proposed as ontologically privileged co-presence. The formal control supplies an arbitrary relation P matching original-frame simultaneity while failing boosted-frame agreement.
note: P is only a logical relation witness, not a sourced complete presentist theory or proof that privileged co-presence exists. Nothing requires a preferred relation to agree exactly with every inertial frame. A philosophical rejection of privileged structure needs further arguments beyond two-frame disagreement; no A-series properties, eternalism or objective passage is encoded.
